paragraphs: Mentioned in [Sukkah 27b (Hyman cites 26b)](https://www.sefaria.org/Sukkah.27b.10): Rabbi Eliezer spent the Sabbath in the Upper Galilee in Yochanan ben Ilai's sukkah, in Kisri; some say Kisrin.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman gives Kisri and Kisrin. The linked Hebrew gives Kisri and Kisrayon.
The linked story has Rabbi Eliezer spend Shabbat in the sukkah of Yochanan, son of Rabbi Ilai. The title Rabbi belongs to Ilai in the Hebrew introduction.
